agent_explanation: Single body in free fall (no walls, no contacts, controller disabled) gains ~78-80 J per step: vy goes -48.80 -> -50.68 -> -52.55, i.e. ~1.88 m/s per dt=0.0319s step, ~6x the analytic g*dt=0.31 m/s. inspect_state reports 54-56 substeps_in_step for these fast steps, so the fast-path substep loop over-applies gravity (adds far too much velocity) while position advance stays consistent with the inflated velocity, injecting kinetic energy with zero controller work and breaking energy_bound. Using dt=0.001 (no large-substep regime) conserves energy, confirming the large-dt substep integration as cause.
